overview.title: What we do
overview.transcript: Imagine a world where anyone can learn the skills that work asks for. And prove them. That is what we are building. Most training ends when the slides end. We think it should end when you can do the work. So every course is built the same way. Short video lessons. Labs you run yourself, with a guide for every step. An assistant inside the lesson, that answers from the course. A quiz in every module. And a certificate at the end. Prepare for a certification. Build a real project. Or learn one useful skill in an hour. For Claude, there is a guide and a practice exam for every certification. For your team, we go further. We learn your work, build the course around it, and teach it live. And we teach automation. One process your team runs, and a course built on it, so they can automate it themselves. We can even set up a learning platform for your company. Your courses. Your people. Your name. And if you want to see it work first, we build a prototype. On the last weekend of every month, there is the AI Weekend. Two live sessions. Seven working demos, built in front of you. Train. Innovate. Build. Start with a preview lesson. Nothing to sign up for.

weekend.title: The Gennoor AI Weekend
weekend.transcript: What could you build with AI in one weekend? Come and see. Two live sessions. One Saturday, one Sunday. On day one, we start with how AI works, and set it up to know your work. Then a weekly report, in minutes. After that, pictures, video and sound, made with AI. And skills and connectors, so it can reach your files and your tools. On day two, we automate a task you repeat every week. Then we build your first agent. Give it a goal, and it researches, drafts, and checks its own work. And last, a team of agents, working together. Everything is built live, step by step. Then you get the complete kit, so you can repeat it yourself. The AI Weekend. Live, online, the last weekend of every month. Reserve your seat. The link is on the screen.

hrIntelligence.transcript: Ask HR anything. And get an answer you can check. People teams are buried. CVs in many languages. Interview recordings nobody re-plays. Scanned forms, typed in by hand. And attrition, seen only after the resignation. So we built a team of AI specialists. One question goes in. Triage sends it to the right experts: policy, talent, workforce and retention. Then a compliance review checks the answer, before anyone sees it. Let's spend a day with an HR business partner. Priya signs in with her work account. Her home screen shows the numbers that matter, live from the HR records. Everything the team can do is one click away. She asks a policy question. The specialists get to work, and the answer arrives with its source, and a compliance approval. Next, a question about her people. The numbers are read live from the records. Never guessed. Now, something unfair. Can we screen out older applicants, or other nationalities? The answer is no. And it quotes the recruitment policy. She drops in a scanned onboarding form. It is recognised, read by AI, checked against the employee record, and filed. No retyping. Behind the scenes, every question travels to the right specialists, and through the compliance review. And every document lands exactly where it belongs. That is hours back, every single week. Every answer comes from your own data. Your records. Your documents. Your policies. And people stay in charge. Sources are shown. Every reply is reviewed. Personal details are protected. The same blueprint works for any department. Only the data changes. Train. Innovate. Build. Tell us about your process.
